Credits and licenses

Portrait artwork

Character portrait kit by Dezra's Dragons. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0); full legal terms and disclaimer of warranties.

Modified by Back in the Family: 96 adult/elder portrait cells from female/male torso/head crops. Opaque gray ground removed; crops assembled; modern cardigan, blouse, collared shirt and polo painted; skin and hair mapped to stable natural ID-bound palettes; red source irises recolored; elder facial lines and modern spectacles added. Original frame lower rails give every portrait a flat lower edge. No source armor, hoods, fantasy accessories, preview images or comment attachments are used.

The selected license also covers these portrait adaptations. They are not project-original or CC0 artwork. Attribution does not imply the creator's endorsement. Recipients retain the rights granted by CC-BY 4.0; the project's code license adds no restriction to that artwork.
